Name: Phainon NPC (HSR)
Author: Farfromdallas
Description:
This is my first mod ever, which means there will likely be bugs. No, I don't know why Phainon's pathing is like that, please tell me how to make him use the town paths like a normal person. I'm more of an artist than a coder, and if there's one thing I'm proud of, it's the custom animations I made for Phainon.

I haven't figured out how heart events work yet, so those aren't in, but Phainon is romanceable and free from The Horrors! I know this mod is a little ironic, but please enjoy having the Deliverer in your game! He likes wheat. 

(If there are any dialogues that feel particularly out of character or bugs, please let me know in the Stardew Valley Discord @far from dallas or leave a comment)

Version 2 Update:

- 2 4 6 10 Heart Events are now in the game! I've included a file inside the mod folder containing Phainon's likes and dislikes, his schedule, and how to trigger his heart events. I'm really proud of how they came out, especially the 10 hearts event, I think you'll really like that one. I may or may not add 12 and 14 heart events in the future, but I think the amount I have now is just fine. 
- Adjusted likes/dislikes-- still recommend giving him wheat
